subject: Data Engineering
title: CQRS Pattern
description: A quick win: understand CQRS Pattern.

hook.text: Your write model is optimized for fast inserts. Your read model needs complex joins. Can one model serve both?

buildup.text: CQRS — Command Query Responsibility Segregation — separates write operations from read operations.

discovery.text: Writes go to an event store optimized for inserts. Reads come from materialized views optimized for queries.

twist.text: The write side and read side can use completely different databases, schemas, and scaling strategies.

climax.text: CQRS adds complexity but unlocks independent optimization of reads and writes for demanding workloads.

punchline.text: Write fast. Read smart. Don't force one model to do both.
